key.name: general-disable-on-battery
key.summary: Whether to pause the video when on battery

key.name: general-action-on-blank
key.summary: What do to when the screen goes blank (0 - nothing, 1 - pause, 2 - restart video, 3 - next video)

key.name: general-action-on-end
key.summary: What to do when the video ends (0 - loop, 1 - pause, 2 - next video)

key.name: playlist-order
key.summary: Order of the videos in a folder (0 - sequential, 1 - shuffle, 2 - random)

key.name: playlist-start
key.summary: Which video to start with (0 - first, 1 - random, 2 - last played)

key.name: playlist-fade-enabled
key.summary: Whether to fade through black when switching videos

key.name: playlist-fade-duration
key.summary: Duration of the fade to and from black when switching videos (ms)

key.name: playlist-last-played
key.summary: Path of the last played video, used when starting with the last played one

key.name: general-mpris-enabled
key.summary: Whether the video can be controlled with media keys and other MPRIS clients

key.name: general-static-image-enabled
key.summary: Also play static images from the selected file or folder

key.name: background-photo-duration-seconds
key.summary: How long each static image is displayed

key.name: background-video-path
key.summary: Path to background video

key.name: background-video-scaling-mode
key.summary: Background video scaling mode (0 - stretch, 1 - fit, 2 - cover)

key.name: background-video-blur-radius
key.summary: Background video blur radius

key.name: background-video-blur-brightness
key.summary: Background video brightness

key.name: background-video-use-videorate
key.summary: Whether to change FPS of the source (term videorate is a leftover from GStreamer)

key.name: background-video-framerate
key.summary: Background video framerate

key.name: background-audio-volume
key.summary: Background audio volume

key.name: background-fade-in-duration
key.summary: Background fade-in animation duration

key.name: prompt-pause-video
key.summary: Whether to pause the video on password prompt

key.name: prompt-grayscale
key.summary: Whether to grayscale the video on password prompt

key.name: prompt-change-blur
key.summary: Whether to change the blur value on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-radius
key.summary: Background video blur radius on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-brightness
key.summary: Background video brightness on password prompt

key.name: prompt-blur-anim-duration
key.summary: Background video blur change animation duration

key.name: mpv-profile
key.summary: MPV profile from external/mpv.conf (0 - quality, 1 - balanced, 2 - efficient)

key.name: mpv-custom-args
key.summary: Custom MPV arguments applied on top of the profile
